transport.title: Train to London
transport.text: The railway station is directly below the terminal, about a 2-minute walk away; lifts, escalators and ramps are available. Stansted Express runs to London Liverpool Street every 15 minutes daily, taking about 48 minutes; Tottenham Hale is about 36 minutes away. You can pay for Stansted Express with a contactless bank card or mobile wallet, but Oyster is not valid for travel to or from the airport.

kids.title: Travelling with children
kids.text: Baby-changing facilities are in the men’s and women’s toilets by check-in in Zone A, and after security near boarding gates 13, 33/34, 43 and 59. In international baggage reclaim, changing cubicles are near belt 9; there are also facilities in the main arrivals meeting hall. Breastfeeding is permitted throughout the airport, with private cubicles in the Family Room in the main departures hall.

lounges.title: Essence Lounge
lounges.text: The former Escape Lounge in the main terminal is closed; the new Essence by Escape Lounges serves only passengers of eligible airlines departing from boarding gates 1–19. Ryanair and easyJet passengers cannot enter; after travelling to gates 1–19, you cannot return to the main terminal. Lounge entry is allowed from 3 hours before scheduled departure; walk-in entry costs from 35 GBP, and children under 3 enter free. Cold dishes, hot drinks, soft drinks, wine, bottled beer and Wi-Fi are included; payment is by card only.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available for 2 hours in Stansted’s terminal and lounges. To connect, select the airport Wi-Fi network on your phone, tablet or laptop.
